text:
jess_support: Heads-up — paying customer (org-539) says Console shows zero usage when they set Region=ap-southeast-1 + Model=redwood-large-v2 + Version=v2026-03-10. API logs and raw event stream show requests (req_9c3, req_9c4) but charts are flat. Seen since ~02:10 UTC. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/attachments/abc123 :frowning:
kai_eng: on it — can you paste the exact filters/steps you used to repro?
jess_support: Sure. In Console -> Usage: Region: ap-southeast-1, Model: "redwood-large-v2", Version: "v2026-03-10", Time range: last 24h. If I clear the Version filter the series reappears. Repro call we used: ```GET /api/observability/metrics?org=org-539&region=ap-southeast-1&model=redwood-large-v2&version=v2026-03-10``` — returned 0 datapoints.
liu_analytics: :eyes: I'll check the ingestion & aggregation keys. Any deploys to analytics recently?
rachel_ops: we deployed analytics-kafka-consumer v1.12 at 01:58 UTC (deploy-6789). The change included a region normalization tweak (non-breaking, or so we thought).
chris_prod: Customer also noticed billing dashboard under-counts tokens for that org. Tagging @finance. This is an escalated impact.
metrics-bot: ingest-alert: aggregation-lag for ap-southeast-1 > 30m since 02:20 UTC
liu_analytics: quick find: the batch normalization renamed the "region" key to "geo.region" in the aggregated documents. Console filter code still queries by "region". Also spotted similar rename where some ingesters emit "model.version" while others emit "version". So filters for model/version/region don't match consistently.
kai_eng: ok. Short-term fix: add compatibility mapping in the analytics query layer to OR on both keys (region OR geo.region, version OR model.version). I'll prepare a patch.
rachel_ops: I can roll a hotpatch to analytics-query at 03:05 UTC. Expect ~3-5m to deploy and warm up.
kai_eng: Patch applied and rolled at 03:07 UTC — query layer now accepts both keys and returns unified results. Monitoring.
metrics-bot: ingest-alert: aggregation-lag cleared for ap-southeast-1 at 03:09 UTC
jess_support: Verified with customer — charts start showing usage after ~03:10 UTC. They still see the expected gap between 01:58-03:10 due to processing/backfill. Customer ok with backfill; thanked support. :thumbsup:
chris_prod: Please add a regression check for key renames — an E2E that asserts filters return data for sample events tagged with region/model/version.
liu_analytics: Agreed. I'll add pipeline unit tests plus a console smoke test. Filed ENG-4051 for the longer-term fix (canonical keys + schema contract).
jess_support: Thanks everyone — closing this escalation. cc support-manager
